description.value: Bisou Bakehouse is a French bakery and café that has been crafting artisan pastries and breads since 2006, with a North Vancouver location near Highway 1 offering freshly baked baguettes, sourdough loaves, croissants, macarons, and a full espresso and tea bar — all made daily without preservatives. The bakery has built a notable profile through partnerships with Fairmont hotels and airline catering contracts, yet retains a neighbourhood café feel suited to a mid-ride stop. Sandwiches on focaccia and croissants round out the savoury offerings alongside sweet pastries and desserts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active French bakery and café at 1189 West 16th Street, North Vancouver, matching the OSM address; the site lists (604) 984-9478 as the North Vancouver location phone, which OSM omits. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. One naming discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Bisou Bake House' (two words) while the website consistently uses 'Bisou Bakehouse' (one word).
